claim: Between effect@4.0.0-rc.115 and a7a71921de there are 32 non-merge commits and 29 top-level changesets (not pre/).
sql-pg timestamp and timestamptz binary decode now returns Date (invalid Date for infinities/out-of-range); rc.115 returned epoch milliseconds and ±Infinity.

beep-effect native @effect/sql-pg is wired through PostgresClient and SqlTest PgClient.make / makeClient; in-process PGlite only aliases the PgClient tag and does not share the sql-pg binary timestamp codec.
effect-drizzle pg.timestamp() defaults to mode string (ISO), so a driver-level Date from native sql-pg is a runtime mismatch typecheck will not see.
Default @beep/postgres / effect-drizzle tests would miss the timestamp Date change: they use PGlite or assert SQL type strings, not native-wire JS values.
Unregistered sql-pg OIDs now decode as UTF-8 text; rc.115 returned a Uint8Array slice. Invalid UTF-8 fails the codec and closes the connection.
beep-effect models PostgreSQL enums (and an enum array fixture) via effect-drizzle pg.enum and does not call PgTypes.register.

ByteSize.Input is no longer an open string; it is a canonical integer+unit template. Runtime fromInput still uses fromStringUnsafe. beep-effect call sites use ByteSize.bytes / S.ByteSize / numeric chunkSize, not malformed Input literals.

Effect.orElseSucceed now passes the error into the fallback (rc.115 called a LazyArg with no args). beep-effect has 369 orElseSucceed hits in 157 files, overwhelmingly 0-arity thunks / O.none / A.empty.

Stream.scan now takes a LazyArg initial state. The only repo call site is source-discovery.ts:338 Stream.scan("", ...), which is a type error and would throw at runtime if the string were invoked as a function. source-discovery tests do not exercise that stream.
Stream.partition now returns [passes, fails] and reads options.capacity; rc.115 returned [excluded=fails, satisfying=passes] and read bufferSize. No Stream.partition call sites in beep-effect.
Stream.mapBoth option keys changed from onSuccess/onFailure to onElement/onError. No Stream.mapBoth call sites in beep-effect (Effect.mapBoth / Exit.mapBoth only).

Effect.isEffect now narrows to Effect<unknown, unknown, unknown> instead of any. Runtime guard is unchanged. EffectSchema.ts:88 passing isEffect into S.declare is the other known type-only spike failure; EffectSchema.test.ts would still pass.
Stream.catchTags now rejects unknown tag keys at the type level. The one Stream.catchTags site (OpenAiCompatClient SSE) still type-checked on the snapshot.
Http file responses now honor contentType and infer MIME from extension. HttpServerResponse.file and HttpStaticServer are unused in beep-effect packages/apps.
HttpApi toRouterPath preserves literal suffixes such as :wait. No HttpApi path in beep-effect uses :param:literalSuffix.
RcRef.make now keeps idleTimeToLive: 0 instead of treating it as omitted. RcRef is unused in beep-effect packages/apps.

The @effect/platform-node-shared NodeFileSystem write patch still matches source at a7a71921de (undefined, undefined at NodeFileSystem.ts:374). Dist apply to the snapshot tarball is unverified. The patchedDependencies key is version-pinned to 4.0.0-rc.115.
node-shared product diff in this range is ChildProcessSpawner process-group cleanup only; NodeFileSystem.ts is unchanged vs rc.115.

The 16 lockstep catalog entries at 4.0.0-rc.115 must move together (effect plus 15 @effect/* including vitest, doctest, sql-pg, sql-pglite, platforms, openai/anthropic, opentelemetry, openapi-generator, atom-react). tsgo 0.39.1 and markdown-toc 0.1.0 stay independent.
Version-sync snapshot URL form is https://pkg.pr.new/Effect-TS/effect/<package>@<sha>; tests still fixture c8349ed.
Spike check passed on existing @effect/tsgo 0.39.1 after the two type fixes; no tsgo bump is required for this snapshot's types.

PR #1060 (merge 6b1ebc8d33) migrated against pkg.pr.new snapshot c8349ede1a then landed catalog 4.0.0-rc.113; it re-rolled the platform-node-shared write patch, excluded tsgo from lockstep, and recorded the pin in the snapshot changeset.
G7 pin-only first PR still installs and typechecks (spike), but it also ships native sql-pg Date/OID decode changes that default PGlite tests and turbo check will not catch.

POSIX process-group cleanup after successful leader exit can affect ChildProcessSpawner users (vault picker, semantica); tests mock the spawner and would miss live group cleanup or PID-reuse signalling.
Arbitrary.array shrinking may change replay tokens; beep-effect has many fcRuns property tests. Most pass a run count, not a stored replay.

ClickHouse, ClusterWorkflowEngine/DurableDeferred/RunnerServer, sql-sqlite-do, Crypto.randomULID, PgClient.listen, sslmode prefer/allow, and sql-pg startupParameters are unused in beep-effect packages/apps.
@effect/openapi-generator now types binary multipart fields as File|Blob. This affects regeneration of generated clients, not the already-committed surfaces that typechecked on the snapshot.
PostgresDiagnostics already formats Date parameters separately from numbers, so native timestamp-as-Date would change log presentation rather than crash that helper.
MCP changesets (v2026_07_28, prompt titles, server instructions, strict tool inputs) are in this commit range but owned by other lanes; #8242 is migration documentation only.
